title: Disco Diwali: AquaTerra's Diwali fundraiser · AquaTerra
description: Disco Diwali, AquaTerra's festive fundraiser in Kolkata: the 2024 and 2025 nights at New Alipore and a banquet venue, and the 2026 masquerade sangeet night.
lede: Disco Diwali is AquaTerra's Diwali night: a dance party with lights, décor and a theme, run by AquaTerra's students, and every ticket funds the welfare drives. It started in October 2024 in New Alipore, Kolkata, moved to a banquet venue in October 2025, and was held as a masquerade sangeet night on 10 November 2026. Across the two earlier nights there were {volunteers} volunteer turnouts.

sections.heading: a night that looks like a party
body: Disco Diwali is built like a party, with dance, lights and décor, and each night was run to give back. The 2024 night at New Alipore had the bigger volunteer team of the two, and its own summary describes it as a festive fundraiser with a purpose.

sections.heading: from New Alipore to a banquet venue
body: Edition 1.0 was in October 2024 at New Alipore, Kolkata, and it is where the series started. Edition 2.0 in October 2025 moved to 60 Chowrangee Banquet, with a photo booth, masks and a silver-tinsel dance floor. The 2025 night's own summary calls it AquaTerra's biggest Diwali fundraising success, and it notes 550 registrations and more than ten small businesses involved.

sections.heading: the 2026 masquerade night
body: The 2026 night was a masquerade sangeet edition on 10 November 2026 at 60 Chowringhee Banquets, with a mirror ball hung over the dance floor. Its listing says every ticket funded AquaTerra's welfare drives, which is the simplest way to see what a Disco Diwali night is for.

sections.heading: take part or help
body: Students can [join AquaTerra](/join) and volunteer on the next night. Businesses that want to be part of a night, as a stall or a sponsor, can get in touch through the [collaborations page](/collaborations).
For the wider picture of how these nights pay for the work, see [every night that paid for the work](/impact/the-nights-that-fund-the-work) and [how we fund the work](/impact/how-we-fund-the-work).

learnings: Name the cause on the listing itself, as the 2026 night does: every ticket funds the welfare drives.
A second edition can grow the same night: Disco Diwali moved from New Alipore to a banquet venue within a year and added a photo booth and masks.
Local businesses are part of the format: the 2025 night brought in more than ten small businesses.

faqs.a: Disco Diwali is AquaTerra's Diwali fundraiser, a dance night with lights, décor and a theme, run by AquaTerra's students. Its first edition was in October 2024 at New Alipore, Kolkata, and the 2026 night was a masquerade sangeet edition on 10 November 2026.
Disco Diwali was held at New Alipore, Kolkata in October 2024, at 60 Chowrangee Banquet in October 2025, and at 60 Chowringhee Banquets for the masquerade sangeet night on 10 November 2026.

faqs.q: Does Disco Diwali raise money for AquaTerra's welfare work?
faqs.a: Yes. The 2026 listing says every ticket funded AquaTerra's welfare drives. AquaTerra is self-funded and takes no monetary donations, so student-run nights like Disco Diwali are one of the ways it pays for that work.

faqs.q: How can I get involved in a Disco Diwali night?
faqs.a: Students can join AquaTerra and volunteer on the next night's team. Businesses can take part as a stall or a sponsor through the collaborations page.

faqs.q: How many volunteers have worked on Disco Diwali?
faqs.a: Across the two earlier Disco Diwali nights, AquaTerra has counted {volunteers} volunteer turnouts. A volunteer who came to both nights is counted twice, and the 2024 night had the bigger team.
